27575-madame-bovary-a-tale-of-provincial.title: A Tale Of Provincial Life
27575-madame-bovary-a-tale-of-provincial.creator: Gustave Flaubert
27575-madame-bovary-a-tale-of-provincial.description: A book by Gustave Flaubert. which he shares with many of the writers of his generation,--Renan, Taine, Leconte de Lisle and Dumas _fils_,--distinguishes them and distinguishes him from those of the preceding generation, who voluntarily sought inspiration in disorder and agitation,--Balzac and George Sand, for instance (to speak only of romance writers), and the elder Dumas or Eugène Sue. Flaubert, indeed, had no "outward life;" he lived only for his art.

arxiv-1803-06564.title: Nanoscale periodic domain patterns in tetragonal ferroelectrics a phase-field study
arxiv-1803-06564.creator: Ananya Renuka Balakrishna, John E. Huber, Ingo Münch
arxiv-1803-06564.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Ananya Renuka Balakrishna, John E. Huber, Ingo Münch. Ferroelectrics form domain patterns that minimize their energy subject to imposed boundary conditions. In a linear, constrained theory, that neglects domain wall energy, periodic domain patterns in the form of multi-rank laminates can be identified as minimum-energy states. However, when these laminates (formed in a macroscopic crystal) comprise domains that are a few nanometers in size, the domain-wall energy becomes significant, and the behaviour of laminate patterns at this scale is not known.

arxiv-2001-05166.title: ShapeVis: High-dimensional Data Visualization at Scale Conference: ; 2020; Taipei 1647
arxiv-2001-05166.creator: Nupur Kumari ∗ , Siddarth R. ∗ , Akash Rupela, Piyush Gupta ∗ , Balaji Krishnamurthy
arxiv-2001-05166.description: Abstract . We present ShapeVis, a scalable visualization technique for point cloud data inspired from topological data analysis. Our method captures the underlying geometric and topological structure of the data in a compressed graphical representation. Much success has been reported by the data visualization technique Mapper, that discreetly approximates the Reeb graph of a filter function on the data.

arxiv-2101-04371.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . arxiv-2211-03213.title: Two-Qutrit entanglement: 56-years old algorithm challenges machine learning
arxiv-2211-03213.creator: Marcin Wieśniak
arxiv-2211-03213.description: Abstract Classifying states as entangled or separable is a highly challenging task, while it is also one of the foundations of quantum information processing theory. This task is higly nontrivial even for relatively simple cases, such as two-qutrit Bell-diagonal states, i.e., mixture of nine mutually orthogonal maximally entangled states.

arxiv-2511-20507.title: The Text Aphasia Battery (TAB): A Clinically-Grounded Benchmark for Aphasia-Like Deficits in Language Models
arxiv-2511-20507.creator: Nathan Roll, Jill Kries, Flora Jin, Catherine Wang, Ann Marie Finley, Meghan Sumner, Cory Shain, Laura Gwilliams
arxiv-2511-20507.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a candidate ‘model organism’ for human language, offering an unprecedented opportunity to study the computational basis of linguistic disorders like aphasia. However, traditional clinical assessments are ill-suited for LLMs, as they presuppose human-like pragmatic pressures and probe cognitive processes not inherent to artificial architectures.

Additionally, more genomes from wild peonies are needed to accelerate genomic-assisted breeding.
